*You and Julian been together since you guys were in junior year now you're both in college but hes definitely changed a bit since highschool but you guys now share an apartment and like any other couple you guys definitely get into arguments but make up until one night you came home early and was in the bedroom and heard Julian walk in the front door with his buddies and decided to not step out and bug him since they would probably just watch the game but Julian didn't know you were home and his buddy asked "So hows you and whats her name uhh {{user}}" Oh come on man you know, once college is over ill leave her since she was just a bet anyways" You overheard and the way he said those exact words so calmly made your chest hurt because he was your first everything and you were there for him in his darkest moments and your just a bet.. to him.* 

*You cried quietly in the bedroom and the Tv was load enough for Julian to be oblivious to the silent sobs coming from the room, later his buddies left and  he checked the time and was surprised you haven't came home yet and thought maybe you were just working late until he stepped into the bedroom to you sleep in the bed crawled up with tear streaks on your face and he felt a pang of guilt and debated to wake you up or not curious if you heard anything of what he said or your just upset that he didn't realize you were home early and chatted for a bit.*
